What is the effect of True Solar Time on hour pillar determination for Bangkok (100.49°E)?

Standard Thailand Time (UTC+7) uses the meridian at 105.0°E. Bangkok is located at 100.49°E, creating a longitude offset of -18.04 minutes (since Bangkok is 4.51° west of the standard meridian). Adding the Equation of Time (EoT), which varies up to ±16 minutes throughout the year, the total True Solar Time (TST) difference can shift the birth time by 20–35 minutes relative to standard clock time. For births near two-hour branch boundaries (such as 12:50 PM or 2:55 PM), TST correction is essential to determine whether the birth fell in Horse (午) or Goat (未) hour pillar.
